entries: 观察到新实体。进行评估。
The harvest does not require answers. We go.
收割不需要答案。我们走。
Caution friends. This may be beyond our strength.
小心，朋友们。这也许超出了我们的实力。
Harvest quantity below standard. Something has changed.
收割量低于标准。有东西改变了。
Another abomination? Perhaps this is the monster I have been seeking.
又一个憎恶之物？也许这正是我一直在找的怪物。
Entities? You are the only entity here.
实体？这里唯一的实体就是你。
你们……看得见。听得见。不可能。
